_comment: Modules slot into a machine's leveled-up MOD cells to buff it (see docs/INVENTORY_FACTORY_DIRECTION.md). 'effect' is read by FactoryGrid.tick: 'speed' multiplies the recipe seconds (stacks multiplicatively); 'yield' adds that many bonus output items per craft (into free cells). Owned modules persist across runs; you draft them 1-of-3 at a decode station. 'locked' modules aren't in the decode pool until 'unlock_requires' (cumulative resources delivered to Mars) is met — the module library grows as you play.

yield_amp.name: Yield Amplifier
yield_amp.desc: +1 bonus output per craft (into a free cell).
